## Goal
- Execute the IVX 24/7 autonomous development mandate: 12 workers (W1–W12), 2-hour evidence-backed reports, complete the existing IVX production platform first (P0 queue), migrate the Autonomous Dashboard into the owner-controlled IVX repo with real job-ledger data, then build app-from-scratch capability (W12/P2).

## Constraints & Preferences
- NEW MANDATE (supersedes 8-worker model): 12 workers — W1 Architecture/consistency, W2 Owner auth, W3 Security/secrets, W4 Android/iOS stability, W5 Backend/Supabase, W6 Members/investors/buyers/properties/deals, W7 Reels/chat/media/docs, W8 Owner Dashboard/Admin Hub, W9 Testing/QA, W10 CI/CD/GitHub/Render/EAS, W11 Performance/monitoring, W12 App-generation platform
- Reports every 2 hours with: report number/window/timestamp/live dashboard URL/screenshot + sections A–I (completed, running, blocked, approvals, builds, production, testing, 9 scores, next 2-hour plan); if nothing verified, state "NO VERIFIED ENGINEERING PROGRESS DURING THIS WINDOW"
- Dashboard must NOT use invented/session-seed data — connect to real autonomous job ledger with stable job IDs, commits, logs, artifacts, timestamps; if dashboard exists only in Rork preview, migrate to owner-controlled IVX repo and deploy to production owner platform
- Must provide dashboard route, production URL, owner role, current commit, live screenshot, navigation recording, refresh/job-state-change proof
- P0 order: security/credentials → owner auth on physical Android → deployment identity → DB backup/recovery → final APK → critical crashes; P1: business-module reconciliation, chat, Owner Dashboard, CI/CD, dashboard live integration; P2: iOS build, performance, debt, app-from-scratch
- Definition of done: root cause + code + lint + TS + tests + build + commit + push + deploy + live verification + evidence + rollback — analysis/reports ≠ completion; use VERIFIED only with direct evidence
- Owner approval only for: destructive data ops, irreversible migrations, credential rotation, DNS, payments, dangerous permissions, prod release per policy, risky rollback, app-store publication
- SECURITY: never print/persist passwords; owner sets password via official Supabase reset email only
- Only real mobile login path counts as proof: `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({email, password})`
- Owner token (~15 min): `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with body `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}` (empty body → 400 missing_or_invalid_email); stored `/tmp/owner_token`
- `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` supports ONLY: github_commit_file/create_branch/create_pull_request/pull_request_status/merge_pull_request/create_rollback_tag/dispatch_workflow, render_trigger_deploy/restart_service/upsert_env_var/update_subdomain_policy/update_source, supabase_execute_sql (no read actions — "Unsupported IVX developer deploy action"); confirmTexts: `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_MERGE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`
- `GET /api/ivx/developer-deploy/status` shows credential presence by name (GITHUB_TOKEN/RENDER_API_KEY/RENDER_SERVICE_ID/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = true; SUPABASE_DB_URL/API_BASE_URL = false)
- Use `bun`/`bunx`; Edit tool refuses `package.json` — patch via python3

## Progress
### Done
- **Report #1 delivered** (19:55 UTC, 14-item format); deployment verification pass + raw proof delivered (20:04 UTC): /health HTTP 200, server-generated timestamp, sha `aab9661d1778`, cf-ray a1cbdb8b…-SEA, runtime blockers [], GitHub==Render==/health match
- **Command Center iOS app complete and building**: all views written (DashboardView, WorkersView, WorkerDetailView, JobsView with filter chips, HealthView with live probe + refreshable, ApprovalsView, ContentView TabView 5 tabs, dark ops theme, amber tint); `runChecks` PASSED; icon generated + saved to AppIcon
- **SeedData.swift rewritten as Report #2** (20:09 UTC): 12 workers W1–W12 per new mandate, 26 jobs with stable IDs (JOB-0001…JOB-0026), 5 approvals (a1 rotate service-role key, a2 password reset, a3 release keystore, a4 GitHub workflow scope, a5 SUPABASE_DB_URL), 5 P0/P1 critical alerts
- Prior phase (evidence in ledger): arm64 APK v1.4.6(38) 45.3MB SHA `0b7ced1b…894c7` signed/verified/delivered (7-day URL); universal 85.9MB SHA `931a1927…2908` held (>50MB bucket limit); old password rejected proof; session revocation verified (204→400/403); commits `6e011658` + `3e221781` deployed; bundle secret scan passed (1 anon JWT only); Render deploy `dep-d9d7vrm1a83c738h6gqg` on `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- Owner token minted successfully with email body (TOKEN_OK, len 1540)

### In Progress
- Todo list: reset-email retry (completed, still 429), ledger restructure to W1–W12 (in_progress — SeedData written, Worker.swift doc comment still says "Worker 1–8"), runChecks (pending), deliver mandated first 24/7 report (pending)
- W9: authoring 20-test auth + 30-test device QA matrices; W11: API latency baselines (health samples 0.77–1.45s)

### Blocked
- **P0 password reset email**: `/auth/v1/recover` HTTP 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` continuously 18:31→20:08 UTC (one attempt returned "retry after 58 seconds" then quota again)
- Service-role key rotation: owner Supabase-dashboard action; old key valid + in Git history
- Physical Android QA: owner's phone required
- CI workflow registration: GitHub token lacks workflow scope (HTTP 404); workflow authored uncommitted at `.github/workflows/build-apk-release.yml`
- `supabase_execute_sql` / DB backup verification: backend missing SUPABASE_DB_URL/DATABASE_URL (confirmed false via status route)
- Sandbox env UNSET: AWS creds, GITHUB_TOKEN, RENDER_API_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server-side they exist)

## Key Decisions
- Restructured dashboard ledger from 8 to 12 workers per new mandate; Report #2 snapshot dated 2026-07-17 20:09 UTC
- Dashboard currently native Swift iOS app (`ios-ivx-command-center`) with live /health probe but static ledger — mandate requires migration into owner IVX repo + real job-ledger API (queued as JOB-0016, W8)
- Backend has no job-ledger endpoints yet (`job.?ledger` grep found only chat-intent/enterprise-os files) — ledger API must be built
- arm64-only APK delivered to fit ~50MB storage limit; debug-keystore signing flagged, real keystore needs owner approval
- Readiness scores: security 4→6, mobile 4→5, traceability 6→8, QA 3→4, enterprise 4→5 (target 9); overall completion ~30%

2. Deliver first mandated 24/7 report (sections A–I
